title: Andruha Event Envelope v1
description: Base envelope for durable Kafka business events.

event_id.description: Unique identity of the logical event.

event_type.description: Versioned event type, for example identity.user_registered.v1.

schema_version.description: Major version of the business payload contract.

occurred_at.description: UTC time when the business event occurred.

producer.description: Stable service name of the event producer.

correlation_id.description: Identifier of the complete cross-service operation.

causation_id.description: Identifier of the command, event or request that directly caused this event.

payload.description: Versioned business payload defined by the concrete event contract.
